result.title: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
result.summary: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it? A reliable generative renderer hinges on two complementary criteria: (i) world preservation, retaining prescribed 4D kinematics and camera paths; and (ii) visual realization, persistently binding text-specified target attributes over time. To evaluate this capability, we introduce WorldDraft, a benchmark of $432$ strictly paired test cases across $48$ executable 4D world families spanning six dynamic challenge categories. Under a $3 \times 3$ factorial design, WorldDraft orthogonally crosses draft granularity (abstract proxy to previs) and appearance alignment (neutral to conflicting) under identical dynamics. Extensive evaluations across $12$ representative models reveal that: (I) world preservation and visual realization remain in stark operational tension; (II) richer draft scaffolding anchors structure but paradoxically impairs appearance fidelity; and (III) conflicting source cues trigger severe source leakage (up to $64\%$), exposing fragile cross-modal disentanglement. To mitigate these bottlenecks, we propose WorldDraft-Primer, a plug-and-play visual prompting strategy that consistently improves both objectives across frozen video renderers. Together, WorldDraft and WorldDraft-Primer lay a foundation for bridging programmatic 4D simulation with video generation, advancing physically grounded generative rendering.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 WorldDraft 基准，用 432 个严格配对、跨 48 个可执行 4D 世界族的测试例，考察代码构建的 4D 世界交由视频模型渲染时能否保持运动学与相机路径、并持续绑定文本指定的外观属性，另提出视觉提示策略 WorldDraft-Primer。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「规定结构保持 vs 外观绑定」的正交评测与「冲突线索导致的 source leakage」度量，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节、以及先验旁路与信息坍缩的诊断提供参照，但属视频渲染领域，需核查可迁移性。
